WITH avg_monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, AVG(sum_sales) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT i_manager_id, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
        FROM item
        JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1222 + 11
        GROUP BY i_manager_id, d_moy
    ) AS subquery
    GROUP BY i_manager_id
)
SELECT t.i_manager_id, t.sum_sales, t.avg_monthly_sales
FROM (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales,
           ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0) AS diff
    FROM item
    JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1222 + 11
      AND (
          (i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9'))
          OR (i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))
      )
    GROUP BY i_manager_id, sum_sales
) AS t
JOIN avg_monthly_sales ON t.i_manager_id = avg_monthly_sales.i_manager_id
WHERE diff > 0.1
ORDER BY t.i_manager_id, t.avg_monthly_sales, t.sum_sales
LIMIT 100
